products.name: Calpac Peeled Black Garlic, 2oz
products.description:
Local craftsman source, ferment and age this culinary gem using ancestral practices handed down through generations learned in Japan. Fermenting quality garlic with proper care and technique brings out its many layers of flavor. Notes of dried fig, raisin and balsamic are present along with aromas of black truffle and grape must.

Cal Pac peeled black garlic is used to add a sweet, savory, and umami-rich depth of flavor to dishes like pasta sauces, dressings, and marinades, often mashed or blended due to its soft texture. It's also great in compounds butters, mashed into potatoes or cauliflower, spread on toast, or used in unique desserts like savory ice cream.

products.name: Oliveri Dried Porcini, 1.76oz
products.description:
The Oliveri name has been synonymous with the best porcini in Piemonte since the 1920s. Raised in the heart of the Alto Monferrato, an area tucked between Piemonte and Liguria with a rich gastronomic heritage, Emilio Oliveri's grandfather became well-known for selling his and other local foragers' porcini harvest as far as Genova. Later, in the center of Acqui Terme, a small town founded by the ancient Romans and most famous for its mineral-rich geothermal springs, Emilio’s father opened a shop showcasing the finest local food treasures, drawing food enthusiasts from all over country.

Emilio Oliveri took his family's passion for porcini - "little masterpieces of nature" as he calls them - to the next level. Over the last 20 years, in addition to continuing to run his father’s store, Emilio, together with his wife Marina, started a small artisanal laboratory to produce genuine and distinctive mushroom products and specialties of the piemontese pantry. Oliveri's young, close-knit team of artisans is proud to create products that represent and help sustain their region’s traditions and authentic culture.

products.name: Oliveri Porcini Powder, 35g
products.description:
Oliveri Dried Porcini Mushroom Powder is a convenient flavor-enhancer for so many dishes. Porcini mushrooms are first dried to intensify their flavor, then pulverized into this potent, savory powder. A sprinkle of this savory seasoning instantly transforms a simple recipe into a gourmet dish.

Add a concentrated burst of earthy umami to soups, broths, marinades, spice rubs, and gravy. Sprinkle over steak tartare, fresh robiola cheese, and fried eggs. Bloom a spoonful in heavy cream with sautéed shallots to make a porcini-laced sauce for Egg Tagliatelle Capricciose. Knead the powder into fresh egg pasta dough or gnocchi dough—serve the finished pasta simply with melted butter and sage.

products.name: Oliveri Sliced Porcini in Olive Oil, 180g
products.description:
Sott’olio (under olive oil) is one of the most common ways to preserve mushrooms, but the typical production process of immediately blanching the mushrooms in a mixture of vinegar and white wine can mask porcini’s distinct aroma and flavor. Oliveri decided to break from tradition, creating an innovative way to capture the phenomenal fragrance of fresh, wild-foraged porcini in a jar.

When the freshly foraged mushrooms arrive, they are first hand-brushed to remove any dirt and debris, then trimmed. Oliveri performs a careful visual inspection and selects only the most perfect mushrooms to be preserved sott'olio. Oliveri's unique preservation process involves first steaming the mushrooms to keep them intact and preserve their firm, meaty texture. This way Oliveri ensures that the white wine and wine vinegar play a supporting role, enhancing the mushrooms’ authentic flavor and letting it shine, rather than overpowering it. The porcini are then placed by hand in jars and marinated in extra virgin olive oil with warming spices like cinnamon, bay leaf, and clove in order to exault their beautiful woody flavor.

Enjoy these precious porcini straight from the jar as the center of an aperitivo. Use as an accompaniment to beef tartare or slice over carpaccio. Top poached eggs or add to an eggs benedict. Garnish seared filet mignon.

products.name: Mancha-Oro Spanish Saffron, 0.8g
products.description: The La Mancha region in Spain is renowned for it's high quality saffron. Famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world, it is made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower. Traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces, it adds distinctive flavor, aroma and color to all your recipes.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Truffle & Salt, 100g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is the original truffle salt! Award-winning and intensely aromatic, it is a blend of Italian black truffle and Adriatic sea salt. Incredibly versatile, it is great on everything from pasta to popcorn to filet mignon. Reach for this salt any time you are in need of the earthy flavor of black truffle!

products.name: Torres Black Truffle Chips, 125g
products.description: The Torres Company started as a family-run potato chip stand in 1969. The same attention to detail and passionate commitment to quality ingredients still governs them today. The result is an amazing line of snacks that not only taste amazing, but are also all natural and healthy. How can you make an otherwise perfect potato chip even better? It's easy...just add the essence of summer black truffles! Like the original, these chips are impossibly light, crisp and delicious, with the added bonus of aromatic summer truffles!

products.name: Villa Jerada Saffron, 1g
products.description: Saffron is famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world. Made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower, it is traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces. A little goes a long way, adding bold, savory flavor and a distinct golden color to all your recipes.

products.name: Seattle Caviar Paddlefish, 1oz
products.description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Paddlefish, species polydon spathula, is found in the Yellowstone River and throughout the Mississippi River system. This prehistoric species produces a natural caviar and is very similar in appearance to Caspian Sevruga. It has a mild flavor and a medium bead size.

products.name: Seattle Caviar Ikura, 2oz
products.description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Chum Salmon are specifically prized for its roe and Salmon Caviar is often referred to as "Ikura" the Japanese term for caviar.

products.name: A L'Olivier Porcini & Truffle Olive Oil, 250ml
products.description: In 1822, Monsieur Popelin, a pharmacist, set up a shop devoted to olive oil in Paris and A L'Olivier was born. Today, the family owned company still makes amazing olive oil, along with high quality vinegars and nut oils. Their Porcini and truffle infused extra virgin olive oil is woodsy and mushroomy with an earthy black truffle aroma. It is ideal for finishing risotto, pasta, potatoes & creamy soups.

products.name: DeLaurenti Porcini Powder, 3.2oz
products.description: If you say you want the intense flavor of porcini mushrooms, but you also want a sauce that is smooth and creamy - this is your answer. Perfect for adding depth to soups, risotto, pasta sauces and reductions for grilled meats.

products.name: Matiz Organic Chestnuts, 200g
products.description: Not just for the holidays anymore, these Spanish chestnuts are conveniently peeled, cooked, and ready to use. Sweet and moist, enjoy them straight from the package or use in stuffing, casseroles, salads and desserts.

products.name: Merlini Porcini Mushrooms, 20g
products.description: Porcini mushrooms are a staple in Italian cooking. Whether you enjoy them fresh, in oil, or in this case dried, they add a distinct character to risotto, steak and sauces. Unlike other dried porcini, these are actually mushrooms, not bits and pieces. When you are ready to use them, just reconstitute them in hot water!

products.name: Moliterno al Tartufo
products.tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
products.description: One of the most striking cheeses in our case, Moliterno al Tartufo looks more like rough cut marble than cheese. This is a result of the unique way of incorporating the truffle flavoring to the cheese. Made on the Italian island of Sardinia with raw sheep's milk, the unflavored cheese is partially aged, and then pierced and injected with ribbons of black truffle paste. As the truffle paste moves through the cracks and crevices of the cheese, it creates a distinct marble design. Although the truffle presence is assertive, it remains in balance with the cheese itself. It has a pronounced aroma of truffles and earth with a pleasant crumbly texture.

products.name: Regalis Black Summer Truffles, 1oz (0.88oz drained)
products.description: Subtle and delicate, these summer harvest Abruzzese truffles are milder than their winter harvest cousins. Perfect for adding a gentle note of truffle to any dish, they are preserved in their own juice for purity of flavor.

products.name: Regalis Black Truffle Oil, 100ml
products.description: Regalis has been providing truffle delicacies to professional chefs and home cooks since 2012. This black truffle oil is made with estate-grown California extra virgin olive oil naturally infused with earthy Spanish black winter truffles. Comparable to French Perigord black truffles, Spanish truffles add slightly more pungency and earthiness to the final product.

products.name: Regalis Truffle Carpaccio, 84g
products.description: Regalis has been providing truffle delicacies to professional chefs and home cooks since 2012. These fragrant Italian summer truffles from Abruzzo are sliced and preserved in extra virgin olive oil. Use as a garnish for pasta, risotto or home-made truffle butter.

products.name: Regalis White Truffle Oil, 100ml
products.description: Regalis has been providing truffle delicacies to professional chefs and home cooks since 2012. This white truffle oil is made with estate-grown California extra virgin olive oil naturally infused with pungent Italian white winter truffles. It is perfect for finishing pasta, beef carpaccio or creamy mushroom soup.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Truffle, 280g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with flecks of aromatic truffle. The savory and earthy truffle flavor makes these olives an excellent snack for cocktail hour.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections White Polenta w/Truffle, 250g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this white corn flour with dried truffles couldn't be easier to prepare. Simple and quick to cook, just top it with sauteed mushrooms and you have a dish that can stand alone or work as a side for poultry or meat.

products.name: Rougie Duck Fat, 320g
products.description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world. This is the result of the company's stress free environment and closely supervised growing process. Their duck fat is flavourful and, dare we say...healthy. Truth: it contains less saturated fatty acids than butter and hardly more than olive oil. Incredibly versatile, duck fat has a high smoking point, making it great for browning and roasting. Try using it in place of butter for roasting chicken or frying potatoes!

products.name: Rougie Mousse Royale
products.description: Rougie selects only the best foie gras of 100% corn-fed duck liver. This 100% whole duck foie gras parfait makes for a completely ready-to-eat delicacy. Rougie prepares this delicate, melting foie gras mousse through the processing of high-quality lobes of Duck Foie Gras with milk cream, egg foam, a drop of Port Wine, and spices. The stunningly delicate texture and unique flavor allows it to be used as an ideal ingredient for salads, sandwiches, and as a stand-alone dish.

products.name: Sabarot Chanterelle Mushrooms, 30g
products.description: Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected worldwide and handled with the utmost care. Chanterelles are one of the most prized wild mushrooms in the world and have never been successfully cultivated. They are both fragrant, fruity and meaty. Great sauteed with meat dishes, in risotto or in soups and sauces. Steep in warm water for 30 minutes before using.

products.name: Sabarot Forest Mushrooms, 40g
products.description: Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected worldwide and handled with the utmost care. Their Fairy Ring mushrooms are perfect for preparing all your omelets, gratins, or soups. Steep in warm water for 30 minutes before using.

products.name: Sabarot Mousserons Fairy Ring Mushrooms, 30g
products.description: For over 30 years, Sabarot has been creating supply chains worldwide to ensure the quality and origins of its mushrooms.

products.name: Sabarot Black Trumpet Mushrooms, 40g
products.description: Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected worldwide and handled with the utmost care. Known as the "Horn of Plenty," black trumpets are considered a great delicacy. They are wonderfully fragrant and have a potent, woodsy flavor. Fantastic in vegetarian cooking, they add a richness and depth that is often the role of meat in a recipe. These mushrooms are delicious sautéed in olive oil or butter, and work well as a smoky flavoring ingredient in soups, sauces, pasta dishes. Steep in warm water for 30 minutes before using.

products.name: Star Porcini Mushroom Stock Cubes, 100g
products.description: A long-trusted brand in Italian kitchens, these cubes are excellent for enhancing any risotto or braised meat dish. One or two cubes in hot water makes a flavorful porcini broth.

products.name: Truffle Gouda
products.description: Melkbus' line of cheeses are made on single-family farms identified by the numbers printed on each wheel of cheese. Truffle Gouda comes exclusively from Farm 149. This farmstead cheese starts out like traditional Boerenkaas (raw milk farmer cheese), until black truffle shavings are generously added to the curd prior to pressing. Intensely truffley, this is not only our most popular truffle cheese, but also our most popular gouda. Its texture is semi-soft and creamy with balanced flavors of sweetness, earth and truffle.

products.name: Truffle Mousse
products.tagline: Chicken liver mousse with black truffle
products.description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Truffle Mousse is silky smooth in texture and ultra-rich in flavor. Made with creamy chicken livers, truffles and marinated porcini mushrooms in sherry, it is perfect with a traditional French baguette and cornichons.
